purpose: Run native-mesh LiDAR, frozen B0/M1D/oracle semantics and the single C08-selected causal graph tuple over all geometry-qualified C09 validation trajectories.

approval.scope: One immutable C09 causal topology validation: 15833 sensor frames, 47499 frozen model inference frames and 50 fixed-parameter graph replays. No training, parameter search, C10, planner or M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instruction: 现在继续推进,定好一个目标我要把整个流程跑出来.

raw_sources: Ten V1R2 C09 original/corrected trajectories and traversal manifests, qualified by the sealed V1R corrective audit.
Ten sealed C09 native meshes, graphs, splines and geometry parameter documents.
Three frozen M1D checkpoints and the single graph tuple selected on C08 development worlds.
excluded_sources: C10 strict-test worlds, M-TARE, planner outputs, new training data and any C09 parameter candidates.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local Gate-4 C09 frozen validation only.

sampling.rule: One unique native-mesh sensor frame per sealed route sample. The same frames feed B0, three frozen M1D checkpoints and oracle; method copies are not independent samples.

teacher.source: Frozen objective outgoing-direction/branch-count and role teacher evaluated only at teacher_axis; oracle is an integrity reference, not a selectable method.
teacher.valid_mask: Every scan must be finite, dual-scene deterministic within 1e-6m and have complete objective branch LOS. Geometry safety authority is the qualified route-conditioned field.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Graph decisions receive only current/past semantics and graph/sensor pose. Future GT, edge identity and world graph remain evaluator-only.

split.historical_pollution_audit: C09 participated in M1D checkpoint selection, so this is frozen-graph-builder validation rather than strict end-to-end unseen generalization. No C09 graph parameter or threshold selection is allowed; C10 remains untouched.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D for 364792320 dual-scene rays, one RTX 5090 for 47499 frozen inference frames, CPU for 50 graph replays; zero training.

evidence.machine_metrics: Ten sensor shards and frame manifests, 30 M1D output archives, 50-row validation table, 50 graphs and decision traces, method/world metrics and seals.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Ten complete-world role trajectories plus all selected graph JSON and failure evidence if a hard gate stops.
evidence.failure_policy: Any input/environment/checkpoint drift, nonfinite scan, dual-scene/LOS failure, coordinate misuse, oracle-integrity failure or forbidden read is FAIL; no tuning or retry.
